measurement.definition: Emoji reactions a reader chose to send on a story, and separately on its generated illustration or satire cartoon. A reaction sent from the panel beside an image is stored under the key of that image, listed under "panels", and never added to the story total. Illustration reactions sent from the older in-story row are stored with the story and stay in its total.
measurement.privacy: Counted per day against a truncated SHA-256 of IP + slug + day, capped at 12 per reader per day. No cookie, account id, raw IP, or durable session id is stored.
measurement.caveat: Only readers who chose to react are counted, so these are self-selected. A story below the floor publishes no total at all.
measurement.resetSemantics: Readers may take back or switch one reaction, so a small drop (at most the larger of 3 or 25% of the previous total, never to zero) is treated as retractions. A total that DROPS beyond what readers can explain (a larger drop, or a wipe to zero) means storage loss, and is published as state "reset" with both numbers rather than smoothed.
